snippet.title: Mini Mecum - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Mini Mecum is coming to Steam may 2022!
===================================
What does it mean to be? What does "it" mean? Two bees? What? 

Explore the unexplored, converse with the unconversable, and have a really weird time. Mini Mecum is a game about nothing and everything and also probably something you have opinions on.

Coming after the start of linear time, and also before the end of it, on a game platform about which 9 out of 10 philosophers say “Who are you? How did you get into my house?"

Made by BluebsTopCat.
Sound Effects from Zapslat.com
